QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] The Corrupted Fairy
QuestInfo.1: Seek advice from the Sylph #bEllin#k in #bDeep Fairy Forest#k.
QuestInfo.2:
Destonen talked about how he witnessed the fairies turning into monsters and told you to seek advice from Ellin.
When you went to Ellin and talked about the ominous aura and fairies that turned into monsters, she asked you to give her some time to sort them out.
